entries.title: Isaiah 57:1
segments: ¶The righteous perishes, And no man takes [it] to heart; Merciful men [are] taken away, While no one considers That the righteous is taken away from evil.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:2
segments: He shall enter into peace; They shall rest in their beds, [Each one] walking [in] his uprightness.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:3
segments: ¶"But come here, You sons of the sorceress, You offspring of the adulterer and the harlot!

entries.title: Isaiah 57:4
segments: Whom do you ridicule? Against whom do you make a wide mouth [And] stick out the tongue? [Are] you not children of transgression, Offspring of falsehood,

entries.title: Isaiah 57:5
segments: Inflaming yourselves with gods under every green tree, Slaying the children in the valleys, Under the clefts of the rocks?

entries.title: Isaiah 57:6
segments: Among the smooth [stones] of the stream [Is] your portion; They, they, [are] your lot! Even to them you have poured a drink offering, You have offered a grain offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

entries.title: Isaiah 57:7
segments: "On a lofty and high mountain You have set your bed; Even there you went up To offer sacrifice.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:8
segments: Also behind the doors and their posts You have set up your remembrance; For you have uncovered yourself [to those other] than Me, And have gone up to them; You have enlarged your bed And made [a covenant] with them; You have loved their bed, Where you saw [their] nudity.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:9
segments: You went to the king with ointment, And increased your perfumes; You sent your messengers far off, And [even] descended to Sheol.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:10
segments: You are wearied in the length of your way; [Yet] you did not say, 'There is no hope.' You have found the life of your hand; Therefore you were not grieved.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:11
segments: "And of whom have you been afraid, or feared, That you have lied And not remembered Me, Nor taken [it] to your heart? Is it not because I have held My peace from of old That you do not fear Me?

entries.title: Isaiah 57:12
segments: I will declare your righteousness And your works, For they will not profit you.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:13
segments: ¶When you cry out, Let your collection [of idols] deliver you. But the wind will carry them all away, A breath will take [them]. But he who puts his trust in Me shall possess the land, And shall inherit My holy mountain."

entries.title: Isaiah 57:14
segments: And one shall say, "Heap it up! Heap it up! Prepare the way, Take the stumbling block out of the way of My people."

entries.title: Isaiah 57:15
segments: For thus says the High and Lofty One Who inhabits eternity, whose name [is] Holy: "I dwell in the high and holy [place], With him [who] has a contrite and humble spirit, To revive the spirit of the humble, And to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:16
segments: For I will not contend forever, Nor will I always be angry; For the spirit would fail before Me, And the souls [which] I have made.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:17
segments: ¶For the iniquity of his covetousness I was angry and struck him; I hid and was angry, And he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:18
segments: I have seen his ways, and will heal him; I will also lead him, And restore comforts to him And to his mourners.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:19
segments: "I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace to [him who is] far off and to [him who is] near," Says the LORD, "And I will heal him."

entries.title: Isaiah 57:20
segments: But the wicked [are] like the troubled sea, When it cannot rest, Whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

entries.title: Isaiah 57:21
segments: "[There is] no peace," Says my God, "for the wicked."
